A staff is a two-handed blunt weapon, usually in the form of a long pole a bit taller than a person. They can be made of metal or wood. Some staves have small balls or other ornamental shapes on one end. However, these shaped ends are mainly decorative, and are not as large, sharp, or significant as they would be on a mace or polearm. Staves are often the preferred weapons of casters. This is because they often have large Intellect stats or provide bonuses that boost casting spells. Starfall Village (or just Starfall) is a small night elven settlement of Alliance vendors and quest givers in Winterspring, the only Alliance settlement in the region. It is found along the main road, northwest of Everlook and south of Frostsaber Rock. It contains a barrow den known as the Ban'Thallow Barrow Den, a night elven lodge, and a smaller house.

Starbreeze Village lies southeast of Shadowglen and east of Dolanaar in Teldrassil. Once a night elven village, Starbreeze became overrun by corrupted furbolgs of the Gnarlpine tribe. The village consists of a few small houses. Ferocitas the Dream Eater can be found in its outskirts and Uruson can be seen patrolling the village. During the Burning of Teldrassil, the conflagration spread to Starbreeze Village before it reached Darnassus.
Starbreeze Village Relic drops from Frostmaul Giants and Frostmaul Preservers in Winterspring.

A StatStick typically refers to a weapon that is not used in attacks but is equipped for its stats. It can also mean an off-hand item (other than a tank's shield) or a relic, since these occupy the same slots as weapons. The term arose because traditionally only staffs, wands, maces and rod-shaped off-hand items fell into this category. However, the scope has broadened with the introduction of caster swords and shields, relics, and off-hand books. Stat sticks include the melee weapon for a hunter, the ranged weapon for a warrior or rogue, and both for a caster. The Starlight Slasher was the name given to the culprits responsible for the gruesome murders discovered in Gilneas. The Duskwood branch of the Wolf Cult makes mention of a killing step in the cult's initiation, implying that the Starlight Slasher murders occurred in Duskwood as well.

The Steamwheedle Cartel is one of the largest and most successful of the goblin cartels in the Undermine. It is a neutral organization that controls several cities and towns around the world, and has allied themselves with a number of other groups such as the Blackwater Raiders in Booty Bay. The Steamwheedle Cartel has made a great deal of profit from maintaining neutrality in the conflict between the Horde and the Alliance. Their services are always available to the highest bidder, employing anyone regardless of their affiliation if they can produce results.

Dwarven steam tanks are cumbersome, heavily armored vehicles, that are mobile siege weapons piloted by brave and sometimes reckless dwarves. These cumbersome, heavily armored vehicles can transport troops across hostile terrain and serve as mobile bunkers for beleaguered forces. Their heavy weaponry is too cumbersome to target enemy units and can only be used on buildings. In Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne, the older steam tank design was upgraded into the dwarven siege engine (adding upgraded weaponry, and rockets that could attack enemy air units).

Sten Stoutarm is a dwarf quest giver located in Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh. Prior to the Cataclysm, he was a friendly dwarf who acted as a sort of postman in Coldridge Valley. He supplied adventurers with gloves in exchange for wolf meat, conveyed messages to adventurers from their superiors and hired out others to distribute mail that had come to Anvilmar through the hostile Coldridge Pass.
Stephen Bhartec is a skeleton at a roadside camp northeast of Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
Steelsnap is one of many monster-hunting quests given by Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff. In this quest, players are sent to Thousand Needles to kill the ferocious hyena, Steelsnap.

The Steamvault (also known as the Steam Vaults) is the level 70 wing of the Coilfang Reservoir. No key is required to enter. You must defeat the first and second bosses and operate the control panels behind them in order to enter the room with the final boss.
This quest is part of the Strange Alliance quest chain. This quest chain starts with Strange Alliance
Steel-Clasped Bracers are mail bracers that give a bonus to both stamina and spirit.
__NOTOC__ The Steelhawk Crossbow drops from Attumen the Huntsman in Karazhan.
The Steelspine Faceguard drops from the Shade of Aran in Karazhan.
Steelgrip Gauntlets are crafted with Blacksmithing (365); taught by Plans: Steelgrip Gauntlets, a world drop.
This item is a rare drop from any Scarlet Crusade member in the Scarlet Monastery.
The Stealthblade is a Level 50 quality Dagger that has a Chance on Hit to temporarily reduce Threat level on all enemies.
This quest is part of the Report to Spymaster Thalodien quest chain. This quest chain starts with Report to Spymaster Thalodien
Steelcap Shield is a quest reward from The Sleeper Has Awakened (Classic).
Steam Pump Parts can be found throughout the Dead Mire in Zangarmarsh as an objective of The Zapthrottle Mote Extractor!
Steam Pump Overseers are naga found in Zangarmarsh. They work for Warlord Kalithresh, guarding the Steam Pumps being used to drain the lakes of Zangarmarsh.
Stemleaf Bracers are a quest reward from The Balance of Nature.

Steam launches are small boats that are enormously popular among fishermen. Several steam launches are often kept aboard larger ships for ferrying troops and supplies to and from shore. It moves at 20 miles per hour and has a crew of 1.

Steamboats are boats that run on steam engines. Goblins offer almost exclusive transport services for the Horde, whether in their steamboats or zeppelins.
